ReviewAccount.description: Which address is the store reviewers' demo account, so an app can tell it apart before sending a password anywhere but Clerk.

addressSha256.description: SHA-256 of the address, trimmed and lowercased, in lowercase hex.

ReviewSignInRequest.description: The demo account's address and password, sent only once the app has matched the address against ReviewAccount.

ReviewSignIn.description: A one-time Clerk sign-in token for the demo account, which the app signs in with by Clerk's ticket strategy.
